page_title: DOR 1-2 STU | Dortmund v Stuttgart 08/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+6' Daniel Siebert shows a yellow card to Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) for a tough tackle.
90+6' The linesman raises his flag. Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart) is adjudged offside.
90+5' The referee blows his whistle as Emre Can (Dortmund) was too aggressive in his challenge.
90+2' Julien Duranville (Dortmund) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Daniel Siebert didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90+2' Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund) commits a rough foul. Daniel Siebert stops the game and makes a call.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.

89' Yet another yellow card and Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) is sent off for talking out of turn to the referee. Definitely a harebrained moment from the player. Daniel Siebert doesn't allow any discussions.
89' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
89' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alexander Nubel, who smothers the ball.
87' Julien Duranville (Dortmund) commits a rough challenge and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul.
86' Substitution. Jamie Leweling did his best and is replaced by Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart).
85' Substitution. Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund) on for Pascal Gross.
85' Niko Kovac has decided to substitute Ramy Bensebaini and he is replaced by Daniel Svensson (Dortmund).
85' Here's the change. Jamie Gittens leaves the pitch and Julien Duranville (Dortmund) comes on as a substitute.
84' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) sends in a cross from the free kick which goes out of play.
81' 1 - 2 Julian Brandt (Dortmund) receives a great chance inside the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner.
81' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) takes a short corner kick.

81' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Dortmund.
81' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Julian Ryerson (Dortmund). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

80' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Dortmund win a corner kick.
80' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alexander Nubel intercepts the ball.
79' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) plays a through ball but overhits it.
78' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
77' The manager makes a subsitution with Yannik Keitel (VfB Stuttgart) coming on for Enzo Millot.
76' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
75' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Alexander Nubel comes off the line to clear the ball away.
73' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
73' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund have been awarded a corner kick.
72' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
71' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Karim Adeyemi as he is replaced by Maximilian Beier (Dortmund).
70' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Deniz Undav.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) is coming onto the pitch as Chris Fuhrich cannot continue after picking up an injury.

68' A wonderful opportunity! Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) strikes from close range and hits the ball nicely towards the top of the net. However, Alexander Nubel makes a great save as he anticipates the shot and manages to parry it onto the bar.
66' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.
66' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) steps up to send the ball in.

66' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The ball goes out of play. Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.

65' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Gregor Kobel easily catches the ball.
64' An attempted cross from Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) is cleared.
61' 0 - 2 What a hit! Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot inside the left post. 0:2.
61' The resulting set piece from Stuttgart is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
61' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Stuttgart have been awarded a corner kick.
60' Daniel Siebert shows a yellow card to Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
59' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
57' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
56' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) is cautioned by the referee after being shown a yellow card for dissent.
53' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
52' Dangerous play by Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart). Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul.
50' 0 - 1 Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) puts the ball into the back of the net but, unfortunately for him and his teammates, it's into his own goal!
49' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) misses a big opportunity to score after striking the ball wide of the right post.
49' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
48' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Gregor Kobel comes off the line to clear the ball away.
47' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.
43' Dortmund control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
40' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart).
40' A pass into the penalty area from Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) is intercepted by the defence. Stuttgart force their opponents to concede a corner.

38' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Alexander Nubel is alert and denies him with a nice save.
36' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
34' The game is interrupted now, Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
33' Leonidas Stergiou (VfB Stuttgart) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniel Siebert no option but to blow his whistle.
32' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

31' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. It will be a corner kick for Dortmund.
30' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
29' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) commits a rough challenge and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to Dortmund in a dangerous position.
28' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart). Daniel Siebert saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
27' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

27' A snap shot by Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) from the edge of the area flies towards the left side of the goal, but Alexander Nubel produces a good save to thwart him. Dortmund have been awarded a corner kick.
26' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
25' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
24' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
22' The shot by Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Alexander Nubel.
21' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Stuttgart.
18' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
17' Emre Can (Dortmund) has received a yellow card for his foul.
16' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
15' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
14' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
13' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Corner kick. Dortmund will have an opportunity.
12' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the left post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
12' A lofted pass picks out Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) in space in the box, he beats the keeper with a low drive but it's blocked on the line by a defender.
11' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

11' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Dortmund will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
10' The Dortmund players are exchanging some short passes.
8' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
7' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
7' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Stuttgart.
6' Stuttgart take a short corner kick.
6' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The ball goes behind for a corner. Stuttgart will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
5' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) is flagged for offside.
4' Alexander Nubel (VfB Stuttgart) plays a long ball to Chris Fuhrich, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
2' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
1' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) and Julian Brandt attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Stuttgart will take the kick-off.
Daniel Siebert will referee today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
